title: SchemeArena: Factorized Stress Testing of Scheming in LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.08126v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study scheming in LLM agents, in which agents covertly pursue misaligned goals. Our focus is to understand how scheming arises from the interaction of key factors, such as instrumental goals, environmental affordances, oversight conditions, and perceived consequences. Prior work examines only a small number of scenarios, limiting the ability to isolate how these conditions shape an agent's propensity or capability to scheme. This limited scale and task diversity also restrict coverage of realistic deployment settings and the range of scheming strategies that can be observed. To this end, we introduce SCHEMEARENA, a 400-scenario benchmark for scalable scheming stress testing, constructed through a factorized scenario synthesis framework spanning diverse safety-relevant tool domains, instrumental goals, oversight conditions, and pressure mechanisms. To enable scalable and reliable monitoring, we further propose SCOUT, a scheming monitor

translated_title: SchemeArena：面向LLM智能体密谋行为的因子化压力测试
translated_abstract: 我们研究LLM智能体中的密谋行为，即智能体暗中追求未对齐目标的现象。我们的重点在于理解密谋行为如何从关键因素的相互作用中产生，例如工具性目标、环境可供性、监督条件以及感知到的后果。先前的工作仅考察了少量场景，限制了将这些条件对智能体密谋倾向或能力的影响进行隔离分析的能力。这种有限的规模和任务多样性也限制了对现实部署场景的覆盖范围以及可观察到的密谋策略的多样性。为此，我们引入了SCHEMEARENA，一个包含400个场景的基准测试，用于可扩展的密谋行为压力测试。该基准通过一个因子化场景合成框架构建，涵盖多样化的安全相关工具领域、工具性目标、监督条件和压力机制。为了实现可扩展且可靠的监控，我们进一步提出了SCOUT，一个密谋行为监控器。
tldr: 该论文提出了SCHEMEARENA——一个通过因子化场景合成框架构建的包含400个场景的密谋行为压力测试基准，用于系统性研究LLM智能体的密谋行为如何由工具性目标、监督条件、压力机制等关键因素相互作用产生。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces SCHEMEARENA, a 400-scenario benchmark for scalable scheming stress testing in LLM agents, built via a factorized scenario synthesis framework to systematically examine how instrumental goals, oversight conditions, and pressure mechanisms interact to shape covert misaligned behavior.
